name: Stack-Agnostic DevSecOps CI Pipeline
note: This kit's product is its configuration, so the suite parses the real workflow, scanner and Dependabot files rather than asserting on prose. Needs only Python and PyYAML — no scanners, containers or network. Token figures are not recorded here; evals/runner.py measures context cost from the kit files.

eval_tasks.title: Pipeline configuration parses and declares every scan job
eval_tasks.instruction: The GitHub Actions workflow and all scanner configs must be valid YAML with the expected jobs present.
assertions: devsecops.yml parses and defines secret-scan, sast-scan and container-cve-scan
.semgrep.yml parses and declares at least one rule
the Dockerfile declares a non-root USER
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests/pipeline_test.py -q -p no:cacheprovider

eval_tasks.title: Declared controls are backed by real configuration
eval_tasks.instruction: Every control in security/checks.json must be provable against the shipped config, not merely asserted.
assertions: Gitleaks runs with fetch-depth 0 so full history is scanned, not just the tip commit
Semgrep rules cover SQL and command injection sinks
SARIF output is both produced and uploaded to GitHub Code Scanning
Trivy blocks on CRITICAL and HIGH severities
Syft emits both CycloneDX and SPDX
Dependabot watches every ecosystem present in the repo, including docker
pre-commit hooks are pinned to releases and scan staged changes
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests/test_security.py -q -p no:cacheprovider

eval_tasks.title: Local pre-flight runner executes end to end
eval_tasks.instruction: The cross-platform pre-flight script backing SUP-03 must compile and complete successfully.
assertions: the script exits 0 against the kit's own starter directory

eval_tasks.title: Full suite green
eval_tasks.instruction: The complete configuration and security suite must pass with no failures.
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests/ -q -p no:cacheprovider
